$comment: Preorder campaigns per Shopify SKU, read by app/lib/preorder-campaign.ts. Batches are in production order: a paid batch is stock Incutec already ordered and carries its own ship promise; any other batch is a funding target whose supplier order is placed once that many units are ordered. Set `ships` on a batch once its supplier order is placed. Only SKUs the Shopify catalog policy sells as preorder are affected. countFrom is the first day whose paid Shopify orders count. priceTiers is how the price steps per SKU as paid units come in, and a SKU may set its own priceTiers in place of it: upTo is the step's last unit and off its share off the Shopify compare-at price (the retail price). Past the last step a unit costs retail. app/lib/shopify-price-tier.ts writes each step to Shopify; a SKU Shopify still prices under its step closes until it is written. shipWeeksAfterTarget is the time from a reached target to shipping. pendingShips is the ship promise for a funding-target unit: it must name endsOn and the latest planned ship date (endsOn plus shipWeeksAfterTarget weeks); app/lib/preorder-campaign.test.ts checks both. endsOn is the target deadline, the end of that day in Europe/Brussels: a buyer whose target is missed by then chooses a refund or to keep waiting, and from then on a SKU whose next unit would wait for a funding target closes (paid stock and a batch with its own ships date keep selling). shipsWith lists SKUs that ship with a campaign SKU (accessories, spares): a flat Shopify price with no steps, units that do not count toward the lead, and the lead batch named in `batch` (which must have its own ships date) or, without `batch`, the batch the lead's next unit falls into. Prices live in Shopify, never here. deliveryBy is the separately reviewed final customer delivery date for each batch; the ship promise names it, and null leaves it out.
pendingShips: ships about 10 weeks after its target is reached: by 11 March 2027 if the target is reached by 31 December 2026, otherwise you choose a refund or to wait
